members.name: Ben Kowalewicz (initially drummer, then backup singer)

podcast.title: Departure of Future Billy Talent Members
podcast.body: Ben Kowalewicz, John Gallant, and Aaron Solowaniak decided to leave To Each His Own because they wanted to pursue a heavier and different style of music than what the band was doing. "And then the three of us decided to leave that band. Which was called what? To each his own. And we decided to go, we wanted to do some heavier kind of stuff and some different kind of things."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: Amp Anecdote with Kevin Gormley
xref.body: At a high school talent show where Dragonflower and To Each His Own were playing, Ian couldn't find his guitar amp. Ben informed him that their guitar player, Kevin Gormley, had borrowed it to practice upstairs in the religion room, which marked Ian's first meeting with Ben. "And I remember right before about to go on stage, I couldn't find my guitar amp and I was like, guys, do you know, do you see a guitar amp missing anywhere? And Ben was like, oh, I think our guitar player boarded to go practice. ... And it was Kevin Gorewood taking my amp to go practice upstairs in the religion room ironically."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Dragonflower Member
xref.body: Before joining Pezz, Ian D'Sa was a member of a band called Dragonflower, which played concurrently with To Each His Own in the 1990s. "That was 90. That was, I was in a different band called Dragonflower. The same time these guys were in a band called To Each His Own."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: Drummer Booted
xref.body: Ben was "booted" from his drumming role in To Each His Own when Aaron Solowaniak, a more proficient drummer, was discovered practicing in a friend's basement. "And it was Aaron. And so I got the boot out of the band."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: First Singing Role
xref.body: After being removed as the drummer, Ben was called back to To Each His Own to sing backups, a role he accepted despite never having sung before. "And I got a call about a month or two later asking if I wanted to sing backups in this band. And I was like, what? So I just wanted to be in a band. So I said, sure, I never had sung before."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: Joining the Band
xref.body: Ian D'Sa, recognized as the best guitar player in their high school, was approached by Ben, John, and Aaron after they left To Each His Own, and agreed to join their new band. "And there was a guitar player in the school, this guy by the name of Ian DeSaw, who was by far leaps and bounds of Ascatar player in the school and a lovely guy. And so we sat and spoke with him. And he said that he wanted to hang out."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: Replaced Ben as Drummer
xref.body: Aaron Solowaniak replaced Ben Kowalewicz as the drummer in the band To Each His Own, impressing the other members with his superior drumming skills. "And it was Aaron. And so I got the boot out of the band."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: Talent Show Meeting - Dragonflower vs. To Each His Own
xref.body: Ian first met Ben Kowalewicz at a high school talent show where their respective bands, Dragonflower and To Each His Own, performed. He had previously met John and Aaron in classes. "The first time I met Ben was actually at a high school talent show. ... It was Dragonflower and To Each His Own plan."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: To Each His Own Drummer
xref.body: Ben Kowalewicz initially joined a band called To Each His Own as a drummer, having just moved to Meadowvale and meeting Trevor Bowman. "And long story short, I was the drummer in this band called To Each His Own for a minute."
